name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 23, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl, Halpern, Mayor Pro Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of July 9, 2025 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Presentation to City Traffic Engineer Mark Wessel on his retirement, serving
  the City for 33 Years

2.  Presentation of the City of Westlake Village 2025 – 2nd Business of the
  Quarter Award - Fusion Academy Westlake Village

3.  Presentation by the Las Virgenes Municipal Water District on the Districts
  Water and Wastewater Rates, presented by Public Affairs and
  Communications Manager Mike McNutt and Finance Manager Brian Richie

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 25-001; RESOLUTION NO. 2409-25 – Adopt Resolution
  No. 2409-25, determining Oak Tree Permit No. 25-001 is exempt from CEQA and
  to authorize the removal of one protected coast live oak tree and the encroachment
  of six protected coast live oak trees located at 5388 North Sterling Center Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO 2409-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 25-001,
  AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF ONE COAST LIVE OAK TREE AND THE
  ENCROACHMENT OF SIX COAST LIVE OAK TREES LOCATED AT 5388 NORTH
  STERLING CENTER DRIVE

2.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 25-001, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  NO. 25-001; RESOLUTION NO. 2410-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2410-25,
  determining Planned Development Permit No. 25-001 and Conditional Use Permit
  No. 25-001 is exempt from CEQA and authorize a 2,435 square-foot expansion of
  an existing restaurant, interior and exterior renovations, the addition of a new 1,776
  square-foot covered outdoor patio on a 2,814 square-foot cantilevered deck, and
  the expanded sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption in conjunction
  with an existing restaurant, known as Bocaccio’s, located at 32123 Lindero Canyon
  Road, Suite 110.

  RESOLUTION NO 2410-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 25-
  001 AND CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 25-001, AUTHORIZING EXPANSION AND
  INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR RENOVATIONS, INCLUDING A COVERED OUTDOOR
  PATIO AND CANTILEVERED DECK, AS WELL AS THE EXPANDED ON-SITE SALE
  AND CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES AT AN EXISTING RESTAURANT
  (BOCCACCIO’S) AT 32123 LINDERO CANYON ROAD, SUITE 110

3.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 24-002; RESOLUTION NO. 2411-25 -
  Adopt Resolution No. 2411-25, determining Planned Development Permit No. 24-
  002 is exempt from CEQA and authorize a façade remodel of the existing dormitory
  building; construction of an outdoor amenity and activity space, screened by a 9-
  foot landscaped wall for Oaks Christian School student use within a portion of the
  existing parking lot at 31255 Cedar Valley Drive.
   RESOLUTION NO 2411-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 24-002,
  AUTHORIZING A FAÇADE REMODEL OF THE EXISTING DORMITORY BUILDING
  AND CONSTRUCTION OF AN OUTDOOR AMENITY AND ACTIVITY SPACE AT 31255
  CEDARVALLEY DRIVE (OAKS CHRISTIAN SCHOOL)

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective July 15, 2025 in the amount of
  $952,020.33

  TREASURER’S REPORT:

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 309-25. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3 – PUBLIC
  SAFETY ADDING CHAPTER 3.10 “ELECTRIC MOBILITY DEVICES” TO
  ESTABLISH  ELECTRIC  MOBILITY  DEVICE REGULATIONS,
  APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION - Waive the
  second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 309-25.

  ORDINANCE NO 309-25: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER
  3 – PUBLIC SAFETY ADDING CHAPTER 3.10 “ELECTRIC MOBILITY DEVICES”
  TO ESTABLISH ELECTRIC MOBILITY DEVICE REGULATIONS, APPROVING A
  CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

  2.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 310-25. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE DESIGNATING FIRE HAZARD
  SEVERITY ZONES AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION - Waive the second reading and adopt Ordinance No.
  310-25.

2939375.2
   ORDINANCE NO 310-25: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE DESIGNATING FIRE HAZARD SEVERITY ZONES AND APPROVING
  A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

  3.  PUBLIC SAFETY ADVISORY BOARD APPOINTMENT - Appoint Clive
  “C.J.” Dawson to the Public Safety Advisory Board with the term ending
  March 31, 2027.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  UPDATE ON THE 2035 STRATEGIC PLAN PROCESS - City Council note and
  file the 2035 Strategic Plan process update report.

2.  STATUS UPDATE ON CALENDAR YEAR 2025 CITY COUNCIL GOALS - City
  Council note and file the report.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 17, 2025 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  July 17, 2025
